Reference-bundle fixture for `-ref` tests, spooled on the dbmint lab (PDB1)
by the script `mtkprof refscript testdata/traces/19c/io_waits.trc` writes.
`objects.csv` and `datafiles.csv` are copies of the larger lab exports
`../mtk_objects.csv` and `../datafiles_pdb1.csv`; `users.csv` and
`plans/52nzchs09dgn1.txt` (the io_waits.trc sort-spill statement) are the
script's own output.
